# font8x8

`font8x8_basic.h` is copied unmodified from
<https://github.com/dhepper/font8x8> at commit
`8e279d2d864e79128e96188a6b9526cfa3fbfef9` (SHA-256 of the file:
`49d8df366296b203ca3211bc0672cf2a762135bf12710735b6292756b19dffd5`).
It is in the public domain (author Daniel Hepper, based on the public domain
IBM VGA fonts).

Strata does not compile this file. `src/render/font8x8.hpp` holds glyphs
0x20–0x7E from it as `unsigned char` (the original's `char` initialisers
narrow under C++11), generated by reading the 128 eight-byte rows in order.
